PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven QA Engineer with 7+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and SDLC management within the 
insurance and banking domains. Expert in Tricentis Tosca automation, defect management, and Agile methodologies, with a track 
record of improving test coverage and reducing manual testing effort on enterprise releases. Recognized for analytical rigor, cross-
functional collaboration, and delivering high-quality releases under tight deadlines. 
 
CORE SKILLS 
Test Automation Tricentis Tosca, TBox, Classic Engine, Distributed Execution (DEX), Test Data Service (TDS) 
Testing Types Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, Integration, System, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) 
Test & Defect Mgmt JIRA, Confluence, Master Craft DevPlus, Test Control Suite 
Methodologies Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, STLC, Defect Lifecycle Management 
Technical SQL, SQL Server Management Studio 
Domain Knowledge Insurance (Life, Motor, General), Banking / BFSI 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Senior QA Engineer — Expleo Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. Jan 2023 – Jun 2026 
Project: Allianz Germany | Domain: Insurance 
• Designed and maintained automated regression test suites in Tricentis Tosca across web and Windows application layers, 
improving test coverage by 40%. 
• Built and managed Tosca Reusable Test Blocks (RTBs), recovery scenarios, and complex test structures to increase script 
maintainability and reuse. 
• Executed Tosca Distributed Execution (DEX) via test event creation and registration, enabling parallel test runs across 
environments and reducing manual testing effort by 50%. 
• Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing. 
• Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA. 
• Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines.

• Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination.
